WalkSense: what the stop data looks like

One dot per 5 s window of a stop recording (Wi-Fi view: one dot per stop). Colour = place (click a legend entry to hide it, double-click to show only that place). Shape = session: circle 23 Nov, square 24 Nov session 1, triangle 24 Nov session 2. Hover for place, session, phone and recording. Use Phone to look at one handset at a time, or Colour by phone to see per-phone clusters (the "iphone" is two handsets: iPhone17,4 on 23 Nov and 24 s2, iPhone19,2 on 24 s1). Same place in different sessions landing together = a fingerprint that carries over; separate clumps per session = drift. Internal team notes, not report text.
